notes: Incremental audit over the changes since 6ef6b86. One security-sensitive file changed: astro.config.mjs, where the sitemap integration gained a serialize callback adding lastmod. That is build-time only, takes no user input, touches no secret and changes no runtime behaviour or deploy config. Also reviewed the new user-input paths added in this range: the website checker's failure branch writes its message with textContent (not innerHTML) and builds its mailto recovery with encodeURIComponent around both the subject and the visitor-typed address, set via setAttribute on an href that is hardcoded to the mailto: scheme, so the typed value cannot introduce a javascript: URL or break out of the attribute. The three existing innerHTML sinks still pass every untrusted interpolation through escapeHtml (3 sinks, 3 escape calls, verified). The new WhatsApp entry points are plain outbound links with rel=noopener and no embedded widget or pixel, so no third-party code executes on page load. No Critical or High findings; nothing carried over unfixed from the previous audit. Still open and non-blocking, unchanged from 6ef6b86: PUBLIC_PSI_KEY needs its HTTP-referrer restriction applied in Google Cloud if it is ever set, and security headers remain unavailable on GitHub Pages and are tracked for the production host.
